title: • Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Bioavailability Following Single and Multiple Ascending Doses of TER-4480 in Healthy Volunteers • Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety, Tolerability and PD of Multiple Doses of TER-4480 in Adult Patients With HHT
official: A Phase 1, Three-Part, Trial of TER-4480 in Healthy Subjects and Patients With Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia
summary: This is a Phase 1, Three-Part, Trial of TER-4480 in Healthy Subjects and Patients with Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT)
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* PART 1

  * Healthy adults 18 to 55 years of age.
  * Body weight \>= 50 kg and body mass index of 18.0 to 30.0 kg/m\^2.
  * Able to swallow tablets.
  * Willing and able to comply with study procedures, including confinement and outpatient visits.
  * Willing to follow protocol-specified contraceptive requirements.
  * Provision of written informed consent.
* PARTS 2 and 3 (not yet recruiting)

  * Adults \>= 18 years of age.
  * Clinical diagnosis of hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia based on protocol-defined Curaçao criteria.
  * Moderate to severe HHT, including a baseline Epistaxis Severity Score \> 4.00; Part 3 participants must also meet protocol-defined requirements for epistaxis frequency and cumulative duration.
  * HHT-associated anemia meeting protocol-defined hemoglobin, parenteral iron, and/or red blood cell transfusion criteria.
  * Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status \<= 2.
  * Adequate bone marrow, renal, hepatic, and coagulation function.
  * Able to swallow tablets and willing and able to comply with study procedures.
  * Willing to follow protocol-specified contraceptive requirements.
  * Provision of written informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* PART 1

  * Clinically significant cardiovascular, pulmonary, hepatic, renal, gastrointestinal, neurologic, hematologic, metabolic, endocrine, immunologic, psychiatric, or other medical condition or clinically significant laboratory abnormality.
  * Current or prior glucose intolerance or diabetes.
  * Active infection requiring systemic treatment.
  * Clinically significant abnormalities in vital signs, electrocardiograms, or clinical laboratory assessments.
  * Gastrointestinal disease, malabsorption, or prior surgery that may affect absorption or metabolism of TER-4480.
  * Recent major surgery, significant traumatic injury, or anticipated major surgery during the study.
  * Recent use of an investigational product or prohibited concomitant treatment.
  * Positive testing for human immunodeficiency virus, hepatitis B, or hepatitis C.
  * Known hypersensitivity to TER-4480 or its excipients.
  * Current or recent clinically significant drug, alcohol, tobacco, or nicotine use.
  * Pregnant or breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy, breastfeeding, or ova donation during the protocol-defined restricted period.
  * Any condition that, in the Investigator's judgment, could make participation unsafe, interfere with informed consent, or confound interpretation of study results.
* PARTS 2 AND 3 (not yet recruiting)

  * Uncontrolled diabetes mellitus or other clinically significant metabolic disorders.
  * Recent use of prohibited medications, investigational therapies, or procedures.
  * Clinically significant cardiovascular, pulmonary, hepatic, renal, gastrointestinal, hematologic, infectious, or other medical conditions that may increase risk or interfere with participation.
  * Pregnancy or breastfeeding.
  * Any condition that, in the opinion of the investigator, may make study participation unsafe or interfere with study assessments.
